recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of five young men in a tiered, seated composition against a textured blue studio backdrop, featuring a prominent varsity-style crest in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetitive horizontal stripe patterns across varied garment colors
Contrast between the cool blue mottled background and warm skin tones
Graphic crest anchoring the top-right negative space
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact with the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a 2-1-2 pyramid formation, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the foreground wearing a maroon striped sweater.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-right crest, moves down through the tiered heads of the subjects, and settles on the foreground figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left and right corners, providing room for the graphic emblem.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and cream (trousers and sweater stripes)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Maroon, red, and yellow (foreground sweater and crest details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value whites against mid-tone blues; saturated primary colors reserved for the graphic emblem.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and primary accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and collegiate block lettering
letterConstructionRules: Arched baseline for the top text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The numeral 5 or letter S is stylized as a large, central block element within a shield
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy slab serif paired with a secondary sans-serif on a ribbon banner.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and blunt terminals.
Captures the geometric, blocky nature of collegiate lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of five young men with 90s hairstyles wearing striped sweaters, sitting in a tiered group on a mottled blue backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a red and yellow varsity shield in the top right corner with arched yellow slab-serif text above it and a small yellow ribbon banner below it.

verificationChecks: Does the crest have a black outline?
Are the sweaters primarily horizontal stripes?

mustRedesign: Specific city names on the banner
postGenerationChecks: Verify the mottled texture of the blue background
Ensure the crest is positioned in the upper right quadrant
Confirm the presence of horizontal stripes on garments
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio group portrait + tiered posing + 90s urban fashion + mottled blue backdrop + varsity graphic emblem.
